source_transition.method: Strip the one unique EOF acceptance marker and suffix; hash the exact prefix as prior CURRENT bytes; combine with 50 current unchanged source hashes in sorted <sha256><two spaces><path><newline> lines.

allowed_changes: ADR-0015 proposed-to-accepted status plus one evidence reference
ADR README ADR-0015 proposed-to-accepted status cell

evidence_inventory.method: LC_ALL=C path order; exact byte size and SHA-256; self and sole post-lock attestation enumerated separately.

declared_unhashed_entries.rule: Final Lock Review 1 recomputes and records this lock SHA-256.
Exact predeclared path; no evidence path may be appended after it.

final_review_requirements: Recompute all 450 hashed evidence paths and both ordered digests.
Confirm final evidence set is exactly 452 paths after the sole attestation.
Reconstruct the Repair 20 pretransition source digest and verify 50 unchanged paths plus one CURRENT EOF append.
Verify exact ADR and CURRENT acceptance metadata only.
Verify durable delivery hashes and strict code-sign result.
Confirm zero staged paths and no product, test, contract, Journey, authority, process, or environment drift.
Return PASS with P0=P1=P2=0 before goal completion.
